revealWordProblem.title: Apply: A New Park
revealWordProblem.text:
Claire, a city horticulturist, is developing the new park shown to replace an old city lot. The center of the park will hold a koi pond covering 1,245 square feet. Eighty-five percent of the remaining space will be covered with grass seed. A 50-pound bag of grass seed covers up to 7,500 square feet, and one bale of straw covers about 500 square feet of seeded ground.
Choose a question to answer.
Question 1: How many bags of grass seed should be used to seed the park?
Question 2: How many bales of straw should be used to cover the grass seed?
revealWordProblem.imageAlt: An overhead view of a parallelogram-shaped park with a koi pond, labeled 150 feet along the base and 108 feet for the perpendicular height.
revealWordProblem.sampleAnswer: The park is a parallelogram, so its area is base × height = 150 × 108 = 16,200 square feet. Take out the pond: 16,200 − 1,245 = 14,955 square feet remain. Eighty-five percent of that gets grass seed: 0.85 × 14,955 = 12,711.75 square feet. Question 1: 12,711.75 ÷ 7,500 ≈ 1.7, and seed comes in whole bags, so she should buy 2 bags. Question 2: 12,711.75 ÷ 500 ≈ 25.4, so she needs 26 bales of straw.

questions.stem: What is the area of a parallelogram with base 10 cm and height 7 cm?
choiceFeedback: 34 is 2 × (10 + 7) — that adds the sides like a perimeter. Area multiplies base × height.
That label measures a distance along a line, but area describes the flat region a shape covers. Multiplying two lengths always produces square units.
hints: You know both the base (10 cm) and the height (7 cm) — this is a direct use of the parallelogram area formula.
Area of a parallelogram is A = base × height. Adding the two numbers gives perimeter-style thinking, not area.
Set up A = 10 × 7 and multiply. Label your result in square centimeters.
questions.stemEs: ¿Cuál es el área de un paralelogramo con base 10 cm y altura 7 cm?
hintsEs: Conoces tanto la base (10 cm) como la altura (7 cm): este es un uso directo de la fórmula del área del paralelogramo.
El área de un paralelogramo es A = base × altura. Sumar los dos números es pensar en perímetro, no en área.
Plantea A = 10 × 7 y multiplica. Escribe tu resultado en centímetros cuadrados.

questions.stem: A parallelogram patio on the firm's blueprint has an area of 54 sq ft and a base of 9 ft. What is the height?
choiceFeedback: You subtracted 9 from 54. Undo the multiplication instead: if 9 × h = 54, then h = 54 ÷ 9.
54 + 9 is too large for the height.
hints: This time you're given the area (54 sq ft) and the base (9 ft) — the height is the missing piece.
Start from A = b × h. To undo a multiplication, divide: h = A ÷ b.
Write 54 = 9 × h, then divide 54 by 9 to find the height in feet.
questions.stemEs: Un patio con forma de paralelogramo en el plano de la firma tiene un área de 54 pies cuadrados y una base de 9 ft. ¿Cuál es la altura?
hintsEs: Esta vez te dan el área (54 pies²) y la base (9 pies): la altura es la pieza que falta.
Empieza con A = b × h. Para deshacer una multiplicación, divide: h = A ÷ b.
Escribe 54 = 9 × h y luego divide 54 entre 9 para hallar la altura en pies.

questions.stem: What is the area of a parallelogram with base 9 cm and height 5 cm?
choiceFeedback: Add base and height? The formula multiplies them.
22.5 is half of 9 × 5 — halving is the triangle rule. A parallelogram's area is base × height with no ½.
90 is double 9 × 5. A parallelogram's area is just base × height: 9 × 5 = 45.
hints: Spot the base (9 cm) and the height (5 cm). Which operation does the area formula use on them?
Use A = base × height. If your number looks like 9 + 5, or like half the product, rethink the operation.
Compute 9 × 5 and give the answer in square centimeters.
questions.stemEs: ¿Cuál es el área de un paralelogramo con base 9 cm y altura 5 cm?
hintsEs: Identifica la base (9 cm) y la altura (5 cm). ¿Qué operación usa la fórmula del área con ellas?
Usa A = base × altura. Si tu número se parece a 9 + 5, o a la mitad del producto, repiensa la operación.
Calcula 9 × 5 y da la respuesta en centímetros cuadrados.

reviewHighlights.watchOut: The most common mistake in Area of Parallelograms is multiplying the base by the slanted side instead of the perpendicular height. For a parallelogram with a base of 16 ft, a perpendicular height of 9 ft, and a slanted side of 11 ft, students compute 16 × 11 = 176 square feet instead of the correct 16 × 9 = 144 square feet. The height must be the straight-up (perpendicular) distance between the base and its opposite side, not the length of the slanted side, even though the slanted side is often the number that 'looks' like it belongs in the formula.

level1.stem: A parallelogram has a base of 6 m and a height of 3 m. Find its area.
level1.stemEs: Un paralelogramo tiene una base de 6 m y una altura de 3 m. Halla su área.
hints: Multiply the base by the height.
hintsEs: Multiplica la base por la altura.
level1.explanation: Find the base and the height: b = 6, h = 3 Multiply the base by the height: 6 × 3 = 18
level1.explanationEs: Halla la base y la altura: b = 6, h = 3 Multiplica la base por la altura: 6 × 3 = 18

level1.stem: A parallelogram has a base of 8 in, a height of 2 in and a slanted side of 3 in. Find its area.
level1.stemEs: Un paralelogramo tiene una base de 8 pulg, una altura de 2 pulg y un lado inclinado de 3 pulg. Halla su área.
hints: Use the height, not the slanted side.
hintsEs: Usa la altura, no el lado inclinado.
level1.explanation: Find the base and the height: b = 8, h = 2 Multiply the base by the height: 8 × 2 = 16
level1.explanationEs: Halla la base y la altura: b = 8, h = 2 Multiplica la base por la altura: 8 × 2 = 16

level1.stem: A rug is shaped like a parallelogram. Its base is 7 feet and its height is 5 feet. What is its area?
level1.stemEs: Una alfombra tiene forma de paralelogramo. Su base mide 7 pies y su altura mide 5 pies. ¿Cuál es su área?
hints: Multiply the base by the height.
hintsEs: Multiplica la base por la altura.
level1.explanation: Find the base and the height: b = 7, h = 5 Multiply the base by the height: 7 × 5 = 35
level1.explanationEs: Halla la base y la altura: b = 7, h = 5 Multiplica la base por la altura: 7 × 5 = 35

level1.stem: A parallelogram has a base of 7 inches and a height of 3 inches. Find its area.
level1.stemEs: Un paralelogramo tiene una base de 7 pulgadas y una altura de 3 pulgadas. Halla su área.
hints: Multiply the base by the height.
hintsEs: Multiplica la base por la altura.
level1.explanation: Find the base and the height: b = 7, h = 3 Multiply the base by the height: 7 × 3 = 21
level1.explanationEs: Halla la base y la altura: b = 7, h = 3 Multiplica la base por la altura: 7 × 3 = 21

level1.stem: A parallelogram has a base of 16 feet and a height of 11 feet. Find its area.
level1.stemEs: Un paralelogramo tiene una base de 16 pies y una altura de 11 pies. Halla su área.
hints: Use A = b × h. You can break 16 × 11 into 16 × 10 and 16 × 1.
hintsEs: Usa A = b × h. Puedes separar 16 × 11 en 16 × 10 y 16 × 1.
level1.explanation: Write the formula with the numbers: A = 16 × 11 Multiply in two parts: 16 × 10 = 160; 160 + 16 = 176
level1.explanationEs: Escribe la fórmula con los números: A = 16 × 11 Multiplica en dos partes: 16 × 10 = 160; 160 + 16 = 176

level2.stem: Leo finds the area of a parallelogram. The base is 11 cm, the slanted side is 7 cm and the height is 5 cm. He writes 11 × 7 = 77. What is the correct area?
level2.stemEs: Leo halla el área de un paralelogramo. La base mide 11 cm, el lado inclinado mide 7 cm y la altura mide 5 cm. Él escribe 11 × 7 = 77. ¿Cuál es el área correcta?
hints: Leo used the wrong length. Which length meets the base at a square corner?
hintsEs: Leo usó la longitud equivocada. ¿Cuál longitud forma una esquina cuadrada con la base?
level2.explanation: Find the height, not the slanted side: h = 5 Multiply the base by the height: 11 × 5 = 55
level2.explanationEs: Halla la altura, no el lado inclinado: h = 5 Multiplica la base por la altura: 11 × 5 = 55

level2.stem: A parallelogram has an area of 91 square centimeters. Its height is 7 cm. How long is its base?
level2.stemEs: Un paralelogramo tiene un área de 91 centímetros cuadrados. Su altura mide 7 cm. ¿Cuánto mide su base?
hints: Write 91 = b × 7. Ask: 7 times what is 91?
hintsEs: Escribe 91 = b × 7. Pregunta: ¿7 por cuánto es 91?
level2.explanation: Write the formula with the numbers: 91 = b × 7 Divide the area by the height: 91 ÷ 7 = 13 Check by multiplying: 13 × 7 = 91
level2.explanationEs: Escribe la fórmula con los números: 91 = b × 7 Divide el área entre la altura: 91 ÷ 7 = 13 Comprueba multiplicando: 13 × 7 = 91

level2.stem: A parallelogram has a base of 13 m and a height of 4 m. Find its area.
level2.stemEs: Un paralelogramo tiene una base de 13 m y una altura de 4 m. Halla su área.
hints: Multiply the base by the height.
hintsEs: Multiplica la base por la altura.
level2.explanation: Find the base and the height: b = 13, h = 4 Multiply the base by the height: 13 × 4 = 52
level2.explanationEs: Halla la base y la altura: b = 13, h = 4 Multiplica la base por la altura: 13 × 4 = 52

level2.stem: Two parallelograms have the same area. One has a base of 18 inches and a height of 6 inches. The other has a base of 9 inches. What is its height?
level2.stemEs: Dos paralelogramos tienen la misma área. Uno tiene una base de 18 pulgadas y una altura de 6 pulgadas. El otro tiene una base de 9 pulgadas. ¿Cuál es su altura?
hints: Find the area of the first one. The second one has the same area.
hintsEs: Halla el área del primero. El segundo tiene la misma área.
level2.explanation: Find the area of the first parallelogram: 18 × 6 = 108 Divide the area by the new base: 108 ÷ 9 = 12
level2.explanationEs: Halla el área del primer paralelogramo: 18 × 6 = 108 Divide el área entre la base nueva: 108 ÷ 9 = 12

level2.stem: A kite is shaped like a rhombus. Each side is 15 inches. The height between two sides is 12 inches. What is the area of the kite?
level2.stemEs: Un papalote tiene forma de rombo. Cada lado mide 15 pulgadas. La altura entre dos lados mide 12 pulgadas. ¿Cuál es el área del papalote?
hints: A rhombus is a parallelogram. Use one side as the base.
hintsEs: Un rombo es un paralelogramo. Usa un lado como base.
level2.explanation: Use a side as the base: b = 15, h = 12 Multiply the base by the height: 15 × 12 = 180
level2.explanationEs: Usa un lado como base: b = 15, h = 12 Multiplica la base por la altura: 15 × 12 = 180

level3.stem: A parallelogram-shaped patio has a base of 16 feet and a perpendicular height of 9 feet. What is its area?
choiceFeedback: That adds 16 and 9. Area multiplies the two measurements.
That is the perimeter, 2 times 16 plus 9. Area multiplies base by height.
That halves the product, which is the TRIANGLE rule. A parallelogram is base times height with no halving.

level3.stem: Ana multiplies the two side lengths of a parallelogram, 9 cm and 6 cm, and gets 54 square centimeters. The height to the 9 cm side is 4 cm. What is the real area?
level3.stemEs: Ana multiplica las dos longitudes de los lados de un paralelogramo, 9 cm y 6 cm, y obtiene 54 centímetros cuadrados. La altura hacia el lado de 9 cm mide 4 cm. ¿Cuál es el área real?
hints: The 6 cm side is slanted. Use the base and the height that meet at a square corner.
hintsEs: El lado de 6 cm está inclinado. Usa la base y la altura que forman una esquina cuadrada.
level3.explanation: Pick the base and its height: b = 9, h = 4 Multiply the base by the height: 9 × 4 = 36
level3.explanationEs: Elige la base y su altura: b = 9, h = 4 Multiplica la base por la altura: 9 × 4 = 36

level3.stem: A parallelogram has an area of 84 square meters and a base of 12 meters. What is its height?
level3.stemEs: Un paralelogramo tiene un área de 84 metros cuadrados y una base de 12 metros. ¿Cuál es su altura?
hints: Divide the area by the base.
hintsEs: Divide el área entre la base.
level3.explanation: Write the formula with the numbers: 84 = 12 × h Divide the area by the base: 84 ÷ 12 = 7
level3.explanationEs: Escribe la fórmula con los números: 84 = 12 × h Divide el área entre la base: 84 ÷ 12 = 7

level3.stem: A window is shaped like a rhombus. Each side is 20 inches. Its area is 360 square inches. What is the height between two of its sides?
level3.stemEs: Una ventana tiene forma de rombo. Cada lado mide 20 pulgadas. Su área es 360 pulgadas cuadradas. ¿Cuál es la altura entre dos de sus lados?
hints: A rhombus is a parallelogram. Any side can be the base.
hintsEs: Un rombo es un paralelogramo. Cualquier lado puede ser la base.
level3.explanation: Use one side as the base: 360 = 20 × h Divide the area by the base: 360 ÷ 20 = 18
level3.explanationEs: Usa un lado como base: 360 = 20 × h Divide el área entre la base: 360 ÷ 20 = 18

level3.stem: A parallelogram has sides of 16 cm and 12 cm. The height to the 16 cm side is 9 cm. What is the height to the 12 cm side?
level3.stemEs: Un paralelogramo tiene lados de 16 cm y 12 cm. La altura hacia el lado de 16 cm mide 9 cm. ¿Cuál es la altura hacia el lado de 12 cm?
hints: Find the area first. The area is the same for every base.
hintsEs: Primero halla el área. El área es la misma para cualquier base.
level3.explanation: Find the area with the 16 cm base: 16 × 9 = 144 Use the 12 cm side as the base: 144 = 12 × h Divide the area by the new base: 144 ÷ 12 = 12
level3.explanationEs: Halla el área con la base de 16 cm: 16 × 9 = 144 Usa el lado de 12 cm como base: 144 = 12 × h Divide el área entre la base nueva: 144 ÷ 12 = 12
